newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni, others to build Thai nuclear facility.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni, others to build Thai nuclear facility.

text.p: Marubeni Corp said on Friday that a international consortium led by it and General Atomics of the United States has won an order from Thailand's nuclear power authority to build a nuclear power research facility.

The group, which includes Hitachi Ltd, will build a nuclear reactor, a facility for making medical-use isotopes and structures for processing and storing low-level radioactive nuclear waste, at a cost of 15 billion yen, a Marubeni spokesman said.
General Atomics will supply the 10 megawatt research reactor for the plant 60 km north of Bangkok, he said.
Hitachi Zosen Corp will build the waste treatment facility, while Toshiba Corp will provide electronic equipment, measuring instruments and other devices, the Marubeni spokesman said.
The plant is to be completed in four years, he said.
